name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
summary: A preview that opens when its trigger is hovered or focused.
description: A preview surface that opens when its trigger is hovered or focused and stays open while the pointer is inside it. Built for previews: an optional mono header with a title and +added −removed counts, and tinted lines for a file diff; anything else goes in the body. Behaviour comes from the Zag hover-card machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: Layout-neutral hook around the trigger (display: contents)

data-state=open|closed. The default trigger is a small mono chip. A label that is a path or a file name is cut in the middle while it does not fit ("packages/…/Billing.tsx": the file name stays), with the full text in title and aria-label while cut; any other label keeps its end ellipsis.
Placed by the engine; rendered in a portal. Exposes --transform-origin and --available-height

The surface: the shared popup surface (`lib/popup.ts`: shadow.raised, motion, keyboard-instant; stacking from base.css); data-state=open|closed. Keeps its 288px width, no padding of its own (the sections pad themselves) and a 420px limit (--popup-max-height).

title.description: Header text, e.g. a file name.

add.description: Lines added, shown in the header.

del.description: Lines removed, shown in the header.

lines.description: Preformatted lines; add and del lines are tinted and signed.

placement.description: Preferred side; flips when there is no room.

triggerLabel.description: Renders the default chip trigger with this label. Otherwise pass your own trigger.

slots.trigger: Your own trigger element (React `trigger` prop, Vue `trigger` slot, Svelte `trigger` snippet that spreads the props it receives)

keyboard: Focus on the trigger opens the card; blur closes it
The card is a preview: anything essential in it must also be reachable another way
notes: Opening from keyboard focus is instant.

motion: surface: the shared popup recipe (`popup`): opacity + scale from motion.popup-scale out of the trigger, duration.popup, easing.out-strong; closes at duration.fast; instant from the keyboard
default trigger: colour over duration.fast, press scale over duration.press
mounted open (defaultOpen, or open at mount): the surface is drawn at once, with no entrance (data-mounted-open until it first closes); its close, and every later open, animate as above
